2615-6562-7296.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-6562-7296.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.

At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, causing you to put an age counter on it and lose 2 life.

Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Glacial Chasm, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, doing nothing.
